hanHanSpacing.definition: outgoing gap on adjacent Han-to-Han atom pairs, evaluated per line

punctuationWidth.definition: diagnostic logical-box envelope plus hard visible-ink coverage; the authoritative spacing gate is punctuationOpticalClearance, and middle punctuation may exceed 1em when measured ink requires it
punctuationWidth.hardSafetyRule: box >= max(0, inkLeft + inkRight); adjacent visible corridors are validated separately by punctuationOpticalClearance
punctuationWidth.diagnosticNote: boxToEmRatio is not a visual-safety minimum: compact punctuation clusters may use a small logical box when ink coverage and every adjacent visible-clearance corridor pass

punctuationOpticalClearance.definition: reader-visible clearance between adjacent glyph ink edges; punctuation placement may adjust both logical side bearings

closingPunctuationTrim.definition: reader-visible clearance between adjacent glyph ink edges; punctuation placement may adjust both logical side bearings

lineEndClosingHanging.definition: justified wrap line-end closing punctuation covers its complete visible ink, preserves an acceptable incoming visible clearance, and aligns its visible ink right edge to target; logical box/em is diagnostic only
lineEndClosingHanging.hardSafetyRule: the painted interval [glyphOffset - inkLeft, glyphOffset + inkRight] must stay inside the logical box; incoming visible clearance must fit the character profile; visible ink right must align to target

baselines.definition: max minus min stored baseline among non-space glyphs on a line

checks.name: required-regression-coverage
checks.limit: all base counts > 0; line-end closing count > 0 when explicitly required

topBottomRepeat.note: A low-error match is only flagged when the top band contains visible signal; an exact match is always flagged.

checks.name: no-top-bottom-repeat
checks.limit: > 1.0 raw RGB levels when top has signal
